summary: On the main Deck, Morpheus and Trinity are positioned behind Tank, all three riveted to the scrolling code on his screen. Trinity speaks into the connection with Neo and urges him to run, repeating the command.

what_changes.before: Watching the scrolling code with the others, silent
what_changes.after: Speaking urgently to Neo, telling him to flee
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus and Trinity stand behind Tank riveted

event_hint.one_line: Trinity urges Neo to run as the crew watches him through the code.

uncertain: Whether Neo can hear or obey Trinity's command
What has happened to Neo to make running necessary
The exact nature of the scrolling code they are watching
